tools.name: posthog_list_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations this API key can see, with their ids. Use an id with posthog_list_projects. PostHog API: GET /api/organizations/.

tools.name: posthog_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects in one organization, with their numeric project ids and names. PostHog API: GET /api/organizations/{organization_id}/projects/.

tools.name: posthog_list_insights
tools.description: List saved insights (analytics charts and queries) in the project, with names, short ids and last-viewed dates. Good first call to find an insight. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/insights/.

tools.name: posthog_get_insight
tools.description: Get one insight by id: its name, query definition and filters, and its latest results when PostHog has them. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/insights/{id}/.

tools.name: posthog_list_dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards in the project, with names, pin state and creators. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/dashboards/.

tools.name: posthog_get_dashboard
tools.description: Get one dashboard by id with its tiles (the insights placed on it) and their latest results. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/dashboards/{id}/.

tools.name: posthog_list_events
tools.description: List raw captured events, newest first, optionally filtered by event name, person, distinct id or time range. Use a time range to keep results small. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/events/.

tools.name: posthog_list_event_definitions
tools.description: List the event names the project has seen, with verified and last-seen details. Good for finding the right event name before posthog_list_events. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/event_definitions/.

tools.name: posthog_list_persons
tools.description: List persons (identified or anonymous users) with their properties and distinct ids. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/persons/.

tools.name: posthog_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by id with all properties and linked distinct ids. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/persons/{id}/.

tools.name: posthog_list_actions
tools.description: List actions (named groups of events and page rules) defined in the project. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/actions/.

tools.name: posthog_list_cohorts
tools.description: List cohorts (saved groups of persons defined by filters), with names and counts. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/cohorts/.

tools.name: posthog_list_feature_flags
tools.description: List feature flags with their keys, active state, rollout and creation details. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/feature_flags/.

tools.name: posthog_get_feature_flag
tools.description: Get one feature flag by id with its filters, rollout percentage and variants. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/feature_flags/{id}/.

tools.name: posthog_list_experiments
tools.description: List experiments (A/B tests) with their status, linked feature flag and launch dates. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/experiments/.

tools.name: posthog_list_surveys
tools.description: List surveys with their names, types, status and response settings. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/surveys/.

tools.name: posthog_list_error_tracking_issues
tools.description: List error tracking issues (grouped exceptions) with their names, status and occurrence data. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/error_tracking/issues/.

tools.name: posthog_list_session_recordings
tools.description: List session recordings (replays of user sessions) with ids, durations and start times. Metadata only; no video. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/session_recordings/.

tools.name: posthog_list_annotations
tools.description: List chart annotations (dated notes such as a release or an incident) that appear on PostHog charts. PostHog API: GET /api/projects/{project_id}/annotations/.
